history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences while browsing around Seberang Jaya. What’s the general price range there? I’m just trying to get a feel for the area and options.

For a rough feel, the reference base prices I have are around RM328k–RM358k. The final price can vary by floor, facing and car-park configuration, and the latest package needs confirmation, so please treat that as indicative rather than a current quote. I’ll check the latest pricing range and package for you.
Thanks, I’ll wait for the updated range and package. I’m still just comparing at this stage; do you have any smaller unit options as well?
For Phase 1, there isn’t a smaller unit type—the residential units are all Type A at 900 sq.ft., with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. That’s the only Phase 1 size I can confirm.
